entries.Along the west coast, where the pearls w: Along the west coast, where the pearls were less plentiful, hardy clans of human fishers and farmers began to settle. Though not wealthy — at least not compared with their merfolk neighbours — the human hamlets afforded a simple, secure life for those disinterested in the wider kingdom’s hustle and bustle.
entries.In the interest of common defense and th: In the interest of common defence and the clearing of new lands, His Majesty Garard, second of that name, calls forth a force of stout-hearted men to wage war against the orcs of the north, being those who have long-threatened our home.
entries.Hello, children. This is a shakedown. Em: Hello, children. This is a shakedown. Empty your treasury or we’ll come to take the pearls ourselves.
entries.First Dad leaves, then my brother... It: First Dad leaves, then my brother... It was nice while it lasted. I suppose it’s up to me now.
entries.Some hexes are <i><b>mixtures of multipl: Some hexes are mixtures of multiple terrain types. Bridges, for example, count as both shallow water and flat land — whichever is better for the unit passing through. If you’re confused about a unit’s defence (chance to evade) or movement on a particular hex and want to see exactly what terrains are included, right-click the hex and select Terrain Description.
entries.Remember that each village you own gener: Remember that each village you own generates 1 gold per turn, and supports 1 unit’s worth of upkeep. Level 2 units cost 2 upkeep, level 3 units cost 3 upkeep, etc. But level 0 units, like Peasants and Woodsmen, cost no upkeep at all. Enemies collect income and pay upkeep just as you do, so capturing just a small handful of villages from your opponents can make a big difference.
entries.Hail, two-legs! I see you are imperiled!: Hail, two-legs! I see you are imperilled! I knew I smelled the stench of naga.
entries.Compared with level 1 Spearmen and Bowme: Compared with level 1 Spearmen and Bowmen, Merman Fighters and Hunters have improved defence (chance to evade) and speed, but lower damage.
entries.Alright. Mermaid, are you willing to tak: All right. Mermaid, are you willing to take the fight to these pirates?
entries.We will not fight here forever, villager: We will not fight here for ever, villagers. The black ship is our real quarry! Let us swiftly vanquish these naga and be done with it.
entries.I was supposed to be delivering tea to m: I was supposed to be delivering tea to my poor sick grandmother. ‘My, what big teeth you have’, I told her... and then my ‘grandmother’ leapt out of bed and swallowed me whole!
entries.My city nurtures the continent’s largest: My city nurtures the continent’s largest and wealthiest merfolk population, yet most of us are not warriors. With Wesnoth’s army away at war in the east, I think it unlikely but not impossible for a co-ordinated group of corsairs to take control.
entries.An invading army. And our neighbors ensl: An invading army. And our neighbours enslaved! We can’t abide this.
entries.Not all units are created equal. As you: Not all units are created equally. As you know, fighters like naga or merfolk have high defence (chance to evade) in water, but pay for that strength by having low defence while on land. Other units, like the Footpad you just attacked, have abnormally high defence everywhere. That’s a major strength, but comes at the cost of poor damage output and vulnerability to most damage types. To see a unit’s terrain defence and damage resistances/vulnerabilities, right-click on it and select ‘Unit Type Description.’
entries.Do not let his death be in vain. We must: Do not let his death be in vain. We must catch this ‘Maudie’ and bring her to justice. Follow the black ship!
entries.The merfolk aren’t prepared to battle su: The merfolk aren’t prepared to fight such a large fleet! We have to flee before we’re destroyed...
entries.She wondered how her father could so rea: She wondered how her father could so readily return to something so grim. She wondered what drives ‘Lady Maudie’ to inflict it upon others.
entries.To see how much gold and income your ene: To see how much gold and income your enemies have, press Alt+S, or open the Menu and select ‘Status Table’.
entries.My brother! The mustached javelineer you: My brother! The moustached javelineer you drowned not two days ago?
entries.I’m sorry, sweetie, you smallfolk all lo: I’m sorry, sweetie, you small-folk all look the same to me. But if you’re so beaten up about his death, I’d be happy to help you join him. Shipmaster, is my fleet ready?
entries.Maudie’s new fireships, for example, can: Maudie’s new fire ships, for example, can deal massive damage in melee combat. But their deteriorate ability drains their health every turn, and being ships they cannot chase you on to land.
entries.While many units are general-purpose, ot:
While many units are general-purpose, others — like the Fire Ship — 
have clear strengths and weaknesses. If you haven’t been doing so
already, consider checking new units’ stats to identify any
weaknesses they may have.
entries.But you’re just a bunch of fish and smal: But you’re just a bunch of fish and small-folk! It’s my right to rule! How— I mean... well, surely you can’t fault a girl for having ambition?
entries.The neighboring hamlets, briefly pillage: The neighbouring hamlets, briefly pillaged and empty, started to refill with their newly-freed inhabitants. Many had died in the pirate raids, but many more had lived, and what remained of Lady Maudie’s fleet now made for rich plunder. Constable Thea took it upon herself to distribute food and supplies, and soon became the de-facto leader of the Peninsula’s human community.
